## PART 4: RISK SCORING GUIDANCE  
### Likelihood Scale (1–5)  
**1 = Remote** (Unlikely in foreseeable future)
- Example: Perfect security system never breached
- Frequency: <1 event per 10 years  
**2 = Low** (May occur in 3+ years)
- Example: 1 fraud case per year
- Frequency: 1 event per 3–10 years  
**3 = Medium** (May occur in 1–3 years)
- Example: 2–5 data entry errors per month
- Frequency: 1 event per 1–3 years  
**4 = High** (Likely in <1 year)
- Example: Regular system downtime (quarterly)
- Frequency: 4+ events per year  
**5 = Very High** (Could occur multiple times per year)
- Example: Daily transaction processing issues
- Frequency: Weekly or more

raw_entities.name: Fraud Risk
raw_entities.description: Fraud risk characterized by likelihood of occurrence ranging from remote to very high depending on control effectiveness and operational context. The document provides a likelihood scale framework for assessing fraud events, with examples ranging from single annual cases to daily processing issues.

raw_entities.name: Operational Risk
raw_entities.description: Operational risk including system downtime and transaction processing failures. The document illustrates this risk with examples of regular system downtime occurring quarterly and daily transaction processing issues as indicators of high to very high likelihood.

raw_entities.name: Data Entry Error Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk of data entry errors occurring at medium likelihood with a frequency of 2–5 errors per month, representing 1 event per 1–3 years. This is classified as a medium likelihood risk in the scoring framework.
context: Example: 2–5 data entry errors per month

raw_entities.name: Security Breach Risk
raw_entities.description: Security breach risk characterized as remote likelihood under ideal conditions with a frequency of less than 1 event per 10 years. The document uses a perfect security system never being breached as the theoretical example of this remote risk level.
context: Example: Perfect security system never breached

raw_entities.name: Fraud Likelihood Score
raw_entities.description: Quantitative metric for assessing fraud likelihood on a 1–5 scale, with Low likelihood defined as 1 event per 3–10 years. This metric is used to score and categorize fraud risk events within the organization's risk assessment framework.

raw_entities.name: Operational Failure Likelihood Score
raw_entities.description: Quantitative metric for assessing operational failure likelihood on a 1–5 scale, with High likelihood defined as 4+ events per year and Very High as weekly or more. Used to evaluate system downtime and transaction processing failures.
